findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "runsheet_create" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: slopscore_check_site, aitab_list_plans · Private data: tokendiet_trim_text, runsheet_create · Public sink: runsheet_create, halves_create_group · Destructive: runsheet_list_templates, runsheet_create.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: slopscore_check_site, aitab_list_plans · Private data: tokendiet_trim_text, runsheet_create · Public sink: runsheet_create, halves_create_group · Destructive: runsheet_list_templates, runsheet_create

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
